PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Financial Services professional with 8+ years of experience across Regulatory Reporting, Financial Reporting, Fund 
Operations and Collateral Management within global financial services environments. Hands-on experience in SEC 
regulatory reporting for N-MFP, N-PORT and N-CEN, supporting investment fund reporting through journal entries, portfolio 
holdings, reconciliation, risk metrics, liquidity classification, asset allocation and fund-level disclosures. Experienced in 
Money Market Fund reporting, including validation of security-level holdings, NAV, daily/weekly liquidity levels, WAM 
calculations, derivatives exposure, credit and interest-rate risk metrics, and investment portfolio data. Hands-on experience 
using BlackRock Aladdin to extract portfolio and derivatives holding reports for reconciliation with internal data, and Alteryx 
templates for automation of Excel-based console activities. Experienced in Team Leadership, including allocation and review 
of daily BAU activities for a team of 4, coordination with onshore teams and clients, and responding to client and auditor 
queries. Earlier experience includes financial reporting under US GAAP/IFRS and OTC derivatives collateral management.
